name: index-options-synthetic-lightgbm
notes: ADR-0169 zoo rung; identical to run-synthetic-distribution.json except the 'model' node. Run: python -m dskit.pipeline walkforward configs/index-options-synthetic-lightgbm.json --asof 1978-06-01.

market.notes: Known truth: vol clustering, leverage and t(6) tails. Change seed or GJR knobs to stress the model; the real-data source replaces this node later.

rv.notes: HAR-style daily/weekly/monthly realized vol, backward-only. rv_22 is the reference scale; all three are inputs for a later HAR rung.

labels.notes: ln(S_{t+21}/S_t): 21 steps; the synthetic path steps calendar days. On trading-day data 21 steps can exceed 30 calendar days, so re-check the embargo. Rows whose horizon runs past the data keep a null label and are forecast but not scored.

fwd.notes: Realized per-step vol over the same 21 steps as the label: the target a scale rung (ADR-0169) regresses on. Every rung shares this pipeline so the zoo compares only the model node.

model.notes: Research A0004 candidate #1: a shallow, regularized LightGBM on the same HAR inputs. Small effective samples overfit; keep trees shallow and compare against HAR, not the empirical rung alone.

score.notes: Locked A0002 scores: twCRPS on the strike zones |z| in [0.5, 2.5], Brier at the candidate strikes, PIT KS and Berkowitz. Val labels overlap (21-step horizon on daily rows), so the p-values are diagnostics, not tests.

condor.notes: Shorts at one reference SD, wings at two, a fixed 30%-of-width credit (no quotes in synthetic data). Forecast vs realized P&L is a sanity check, never a selection criterion (A0003).

walkforward.notes: Expanding train windows. The 30-day embargo exceeds the 21-step label reach, so no train label sees a val price.
